paper_title: MMRA A Benchmark for Evaluating Multi-Granularity and Multi-Image   Relational Association Capabilities in Large Visual Language Models
caption: The number and ratio of each subtask in our MMRA benchmark. The integers in the graph represent the number of samples in each task, while the percentages in parentheses indicate the proportion of each task in the entire benchmark.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of subtasks within the MMRA benchmark, showing the number and proportion of samples for each category. The chart contains eight slices, representing the categories: NearSameEntity (grey, 6.34%), ObservationAngle (teal, 12.28%), RelativePosition (dark grey, 7.90%), SimilarMaterial (light green, 10.33%), MentalitySimilarity (cyan, 8.67%), SimilarEvent (blue, 8.77%), AppearanceSimilarity (yellow, 8.77%), UsageSimilarity (green, 9.65%), SubEvent (red, 9.74%), Environment (orange, 8.77%), and Layout (gold, 8.77%). Each slice is labeled with the category name and its corresponding count and percentage, displayed inside the slice. The slices appear to be ordered roughly in descending order by their numerical count, although not perfectly. A legend is not present as the labels are directly on the slices.
